description:
Role: Java developer with Maven , GIT
Location: Rocklin, CA 
Duration: long term

Skills:
Technically lead the implementation of a cloud based Java/J2EE solution for a leading payment services client. 
In this role, the candidate will be doing requirement analysis, design and development of a Java, J2EE web application, troubleshooting of issues found by team and customer and code reviews. The candidate will be the customer interface for all technical activities at customer location. 
The following skills are required for this role: 
Java/J2EE design and development
Knowledge of Maven and GIT 
Knowledge of Artifactory and Jenkins 
Working knowledge with Oracle database
Application hosting (setup and configuration) in a public cloud like AWS 
Automated unit testing and static code analysis 


 Java developer with Maven , GIT,AWS,jenkins


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
